#### I'm building a nested React component hierarchy and getting a prop drilling warning

> npm run build
> Warning: Each child in a list should have a unique "key" prop

The warning is about missing keys in a list render, not prop drilling. Make sure each mapped element has a unique key:

```jsx
{items.map(item => (
  <NestedReactComponent key={item.id} title={item.title} />
))}
```

If you're seeing actual prop drilling issues, consider using React Context to pass data down the nested React component tree without threading props through every level.

#### That makes sense, I'll refactor to use Context for the deeper levels.
